{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers AND completed status

total_loyal_completed = len(df_loyal_completed)
converted_loyal_completed = df_loyal_completed['converted'].sum()

# Compute fraction converted
total_loyal_completed, converted_loyal_completed, converted_loyal_completed / total_loyal_completed"}
